integrity: General equivalence is established by a self-contained set-theoretic proof. A standalone exhaustive finite checker supports but does not establish the all-size statement. A separate independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-agent S5 finite labelled frames with every subset available as a valuation; no claim about three or more agents, infinite-frame counting, or distinct bundled-operator census. Priority relative to all partition-enumeration literature is not fully established.
title: Normality islands for two-agent somebody-knows on finite S5 frames
